newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks climb,inspired by strong U.S. markets.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks climb,inspired by strong U.S. markets.

text.p: Tokyo stocks climbed in early morning trade on Tuesday, inspired by strength in U.S. markets overnight, brokers said.
Demand for shares of importers and firms reliant on domestic demand was spilling over from the previous day.
After 18 minutes of trade, the Nikkei average was up 201.42 points or 1.00 percent at 20,344.93. Its June futures rose 170 to 20,360.

"Sentiment has been improving lately helped by pension and public funds, and the market is in the right frame of mind to respond favourably to the jump in Wall Street overnight," said Kenji Karikomi at Daiwa Securities Co Ltd.
